title: Biology lab
description: A teaching biology laboratory with rows of benches, microscopes and glassware, sinks, fume hoods and a chalkboard.

tasks.text: On the middle island bench in the row with the cover tray, pick up the middle reagent bottle in the row of three beside the tissue box. Set it on the seat of the wood stool nearest the microscope across that same bench from the bottle.

locatorSteps.label: Pick up the middle reagent bottle.
Place the bottle on this stool seat.

tasks.text: Find the row of three glove boxes near the microcentrifuge. Push the middle glove box from the edge toward the middle of that island bench.

locatorSteps.label: Push the middle glove box inward along the bench.

tasks.text: Lift the glass slide from the open slide box. Set it in the stage guide of the microscope closest to that box, release the slide, then close the slide box.

locatorSteps.label: Lift this glass slide from its open box.
Release the slide in this microscope’s stage guide.
Close the empty slide box.

tasks.text: Open the lower of the two stacked incubators and lift out the sample dish. Set the dish upright on the work surface inside the biosafety cabinet beside the stack, on the side away from the refrigerator. Release the dish and close the lower incubator.

locatorSteps.label: Open the lower incubator.
Lift the dish out.
Set the dish upright inside this cabinet.
Close the lower incubator.

tasks.text: Open the microcentrifuge beside the two tube stands. Take one microtube from each stand, place the two microtubes in opposite sockets in the rotor, release them, and close the lid.

locatorSteps.label: Open the microcentrifuge.
Take the first microtube from its stand.
Seat the tube in a rotor socket.
Take the second microtube.
Seat it opposite the first tube and close the lid.

tasks.text: Lift the cloth covering the microscope beside the cover tray. Lay the cloth in the cover tray and release it.

locatorSteps.label: Lift the cloth off the microscope.
Lay the cloth in this tray and release it.

tasks.text: Start with the cloth in the cover tray. Lift it from the tray and spread it over the optics of the microscope beside the tray. Release the cloth so it stays draped over the optics.

locatorSteps.label: Start with the cloth in this tray.
Spread the cloth over this microscope and release it.

tasks.text: Find the biosafety cabinet nearest the refrigerator. Slide its front sash upward and leave it raised.

locatorSteps.label: Raise the front sash and leave it up.

tasks.text: Open the top drawer of the drawer cabinet. Pick up the lab notebook beside the dry bath on the nearest island bench, put it in that drawer, and close the drawer.

locatorSteps.label: Open the top drawer.
Pick up this notebook.
Place the notebook inside and close the drawer.

tasks.text: Open the refrigerator. In the adjacent biosafety cabinet, pick up the culture bottle closest to the refrigerator. Set it on a shelf inside the refrigerator and close the door.

locatorSteps.label: Open this refrigerator.
Pick up this bottle from the adjacent cabinet.
Place it on a shelf and close the door.
